evidence.says: Michael E. Williams Sr. wrote Isaac Taylor Tichenor and To God Be the Glory and is a professor at Dallas Baptist University.
Michael Edward Williams's dissertation on Isaac Taylor Tichenor was submitted at Southwestern Baptist Theological Seminary in 1993.
Michael Williams received a history PhD from UC Irvine in 1992 for America and the First Congo Crisis, 1960–1963.

basis: The LC book author and the candidate wrote different doctoral dissertations at different institutions in adjacent years. The publisher ties the LC books to the author of the Tichenor dissertation, while the candidate's own profile identifies the Irvine dissertation.

evidence.says: LC identifies H. Reid, author of The Virginian Railway, as Harold Alfred Reid and records his death in 1992.
Peter H Reid of Robert Gordon University coauthored The People Behind the Philanthropy in 2008.

basis: The LC authority identifies Harold Alfred Reid and records his death in 1992. The candidate Peter H. Reid coauthored a listed work in 2008, so they are different people.
